title: Careers
intro: We're a small team building considered footwear without the fast-fashion cycle. If that sounds like you, we'd like to hear from you — even without a specific role open.

sections.heading: Open Positions
sections.body: There are no open roles listed right now. We hire in small numbers, close to need — check back, or write to us directly with what you're interested in.

sections.heading: How We Work
sections.body: Small team, direct ownership, no layers of approval between an idea and shipping it. We care more about judgment and craft than years of experience on a resume.

sections.heading: Get in Touch
sections.body: Send a short note and portfolio or CV to alexandrisstores@gmail.com. We read everything, even when there's nothing open.
